sentences.l2: 周末的傍晚，林悦把手机架在厨房的窗台上，接通了与母亲的视频通话。
sentences.l1: On a weekend evening, Lin Yue propped her phone on the kitchen windowsill and connected a video call with her mother.

sentences.l2: 屏幕那端，母亲系着围裙，手里正握着锅铲，准备手把手地教她做那道从小吃到大的家常菜——番茄炒蛋。
sentences.l1: On the other end of the screen, her mother, wearing an apron and holding a spatula in her hand, was about to teach her, step by step, the home-style dish she had eaten since childhood: tomato and egg stir-fry.

sentences.l2: 这道菜看似简单，实则暗藏玄机。
sentences.l1: This dish seems simple, but actually hides some tricks.

sentences.l2: 母亲反复强调，火候是成败的关键：油温过高，蛋液会瞬间焦糊；温度不足，鸡蛋又难以蓬松。
sentences.l1: Her mother stressed repeatedly that the heat is the key to success or failure: if the oil is too hot, the beaten egg will scorch in an instant; if the temperature is not enough, the egg will have difficulty becoming fluffy.

sentences.l2: 林悦依言调整火力，眼见蛋液边缘微微起泡，才缓缓推入切好的番茄。
sentences.l1: Lin Yue adjusted the heat as told, and only after seeing the edges of the beaten egg bubble slightly did she slowly push in the cut tomatoes.

sentences.l2: 至于调料，母亲只让她放一小撮糖。
sentences.l1: As for seasoning, her mother only let her add a small pinch of sugar.

sentences.l2: 这个看似多余的举动，恰恰能中和番茄的酸涩，让鲜味层层递进。
sentences.l1: This seemingly superfluous act precisely neutralizes the sourness and astringency of the tomato, letting the savory flavor deepen layer by layer.

sentences.l2: 当酸甜的香气漫出屏幕，林悦忽然明白，所谓家的味道，从来不是某一种配方，而是有人愿意隔着一方屏幕，把琐碎的分寸一寸寸交到你手上。
sentences.l1: When the sweet and sour aroma spilled out of the screen, Lin Yue suddenly understood that the so-called taste of home has never been one particular recipe, but someone being willing, across a screen, to hand you the small details of proportion bit by bit.
